# bintables/streq

> Helper: `__pk_streq` compares the strings in rax and rbx; rax is 1 if equal.

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/streq.pkg)

Compares the lengths, then the bytes with `repe cmpsb`. Clobbers `rcx`,
`rsi` and `rdi`.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm

```

## Support code (once per program)

```nasm
__pk_streq:
mov rcx, [rax]
cmp rcx, [rbx]
jne .differ
lea rsi, [rax+8]
lea rdi, [rbx+8]
repe cmpsb
jne .differ
mov eax, 1
ret
.differ:
xor eax, eax
ret
```
